doc_title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast and Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 通期連結業績予想の修正及び期末配当予想の修正(増配)に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 上方修正された連結業績予想を踏まえ、適切な販売価格反映とコスト管理により利益が前回予想を上回る見込み

summary_en: Daiki Axis raised full-year dividend guidance for fiscal 2026 to 26 yen per share from 24 yen, a 2 yen increase from the prior year, comprising an interim dividend of 12 yen and a year-end dividend of 14 yen (up 2 yen), following upward revisions to operating and net profit forecasts driven by improved cost management and price adjustments.
summary_jp: 2026年12月期の通期配当を26円（前期比2円増）に修正。中間配当12円、期末配当14円。営業利益・当期純利益予想の上方修正を受け、販売価格の適切な反映とコスト管理の実績を踏まえた増配。
